$comment: Exact counts the inventory guard expects. A change that moves a variable to mapped or settable updates these numbers in the same commit; a change that lowers one adds the name and why under removals.

removals.--color-info-rgb: settable -> mapped (decision 244, 15 Oct 2026): overrides.css maps it to --nldesign-color-info-rgb, which 63 sets carry, so the set's info colour reaches it; tests/vitest/infoRgbMapping.spec.js measures it.
